entries.title: Matthew 14:1
segments: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus

entries.title: Matthew 14:2
segments: and said to his servants, This is John the Baptist. He has risen from the dead, and therefore the powerful works [are] working in him.

entries.title: Matthew 14:3
segments: For Herod had laid hold on John, and had bound him, and had put [him] in prison because of Herodias his brother Philip's wife.

entries.title: Matthew 14:4
segments: For John said to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

entries.title: Matthew 14:5
segments: And when he desired to put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

entries.title: Matthew 14:6
segments: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod.

entries.title: Matthew 14:7
segments: So he promised with an oath to give her whatever she would ask.

entries.title: Matthew 14:8
segments: And she, being instructed before by her mother, said, Give me John the Baptist's head here on a platter.

entries.title: Matthew 14:9
segments: And the king was sorry. But for the oath's sake, and those reclining with [him], he commanded [it] to be given.

entries.title: Matthew 14:10
segments: And he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

entries.title: Matthew 14:11
segments: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl. And she brought [it] to her mother.

entries.title: Matthew 14:12
segments: And his disciples came and took up the body and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

entries.title: Matthew 14:13
segments: When Jesus heard, He departed from there by boat into a deserted place apart. And hearing, the crowds followed Him on foot out of the cities.

entries.title: Matthew 14:14
segments: And Jesus went out and saw a great crowd, and He was moved with compassion toward them. And He healed their sick.

entries.title: Matthew 14:15
segments: And evening coming on, His disciples came to Him, saying, The place is deserted and the time has already gone by. Send the crowd away so that they may go into the villages and buy food for themselves.

entries.title: Matthew 14:16
segments: But Jesus said to them, They do not need to leave, you give them [something] to eat.

entries.title: Matthew 14:17
segments: And they said to Him, We have here only five loaves and two fish.

entries.title: Matthew 14:18
segments: And He said, Bring them here to Me.

entries.title: Matthew 14:19
segments: And He commanded the crowd to recline on the grass. And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to Heaven He blessed and broke, and gave the loaves to [His] disciples. And the disciples [gave] to the crowd.

entries.title: Matthew 14:20
segments: And they all ate and were filled. And they took up twelve hand baskets full from the fragments that remained.

entries.title: Matthew 14:21
segments: And they who had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

entries.title: Matthew 14:22
segments: And immediately Jesus constrained His disciples to get into a boat and to go before Him to the other side, while He sent the crowds away.

entries.title: Matthew 14:23
segments: And when He had sent the crowds away, He went up into a mountain apart to pray. And when evening had come, He was there alone.

entries.title: Matthew 14:24
segments: But the boat was now in [the] midst of the sea, tossed with waves; for the wind was against them.

entries.title: Matthew 14:25
segments: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went to them, walking on the sea.

entries.title: Matthew 14:26
segments: And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a phantom! And they cried out for fear.

entries.title: Matthew 14:27
segments: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, Be of good cheer, I AM! Do not fear.

entries.title: Matthew 14:28
segments: And Peter answered Him and said, LORD, if it is You, tell me to come to You on the water.

entries.title: Matthew 14:29
segments: And He said, Come. And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus.

entries.title: Matthew 14:30
segments: But seeing that the wind was strong, he was afraid. And beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me!

entries.title: Matthew 14:31
segments: And immediately Jesus stretched out [His] hand and caught him; and said to him, Little-faith! Why did you doubt?

entries.title: Matthew 14:32
segments: And when they had come into the boat, the wind ceased.

entries.title: Matthew 14:33
segments: And those in the boat came and worshiped Him, saying, Truly You are the Son of God.

entries.title: Matthew 14:34
segments: And when they had passed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

entries.title: Matthew 14:35
segments: And recognizing Him, the men of that place sent to all that neighborhood, and brought to Him all who were diseased.

entries.title: Matthew 14:36
segments: And [they] begged Him that they might only touch the hem of His robe. And as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
